notes.title: 1.1 update!
notes.content:
Ghostlords 1.1 is now live! Here's what's new:

[list]
    [*]The Shadowfiend, an evil ghost made of darkness.
    [*]The Protector, a righteous ghost that attacks with a morning star.
    [*]The Boltzor, an electrically charged apparition.
    [*]The Freezer, a ghost that has possessed a common household appliance.
    [*]The Wetwink, a funny little ghost that loves to hug people.
    [*]Many new encounters that may present themselves to your during your travels.
    [*]Various bug fixes. Additionally, any errors that do occur will give you the chance to reset your save progress to an earlier checkpoint to help prevent any loss of progression.
[/list]

Enjoy!

notes.title: 1.0.4 released
notes.content:
Patch 1.0.4 is now live. A couple of small fixes:

- The mysterious "Error Ghost" should now be much more elusive.
- Fixed an error that could occur on Linux.

Patch 1.0.3 is now live. Fixes include:

- Fixed a error in an enemy Ghostlord encounter, where paying to escape the encounter would break the game.
- Fixed a error in 'The Gauntlet' when a ghost would try to offer you a relic.

notes.title: Release day!
notes.content:
Ghostlords is now available to play! I hope everyone enjoys it and don't forget to check out the Workshop content!

Over the coming weeks I'll be working on adding more content to the game, which will be released as part of a 1.1 content patch. Stay tuned!

notes.title: 18th November!
notes.content:
Ghostlords will be released on Friday the 18th November! It will launch with five full campaigns, fifty ghosts, and countless quests and encounters. Not to mention workshop support, letting you create and download user-created content.

Plus, there will be more official content added down the line! Stay tuned.
